data.body: Experiment result (2026-09-07, scratch worktree at origin/main 4c77d6f3e96f, `git mv tests/unit/rebar_reconciler tests/unit/reconciler` only): the 29-key list is complete. After the rename `--check` reports `new=36 stale=29`; the 29 stale are all `autouse_fixture` under the old path, the 36 new are the same 29 at the new path plus the 7 marker-admitted mechanisms that are already `new` on the clean tree (see bug amoeboid-amateur-guillemot); no other kind or path appears. A prefix-only re-spell keeps the file sorted here (the block's neighbours are `tests/unit/grounding/...` and `tests/unit/test_agent_build_invariants.py`), so no re-sort is needed for this file; after it, `--check` is identical to the clean tree (`active=682 new=7 increased=0 stale=0`, exit 0) and `test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree` plus `test_check_passes_on_the_committed_tree` pass. The reviewer suffix-check posted above, run on main's copy and the re-spelled copy, produces 29 lines each and an empty diff. `tests/_repo_root.py` exists on main and defines `repo_root()` at line 32, so folding `tests/_engine_path.py`'s callers onto it is a plain substitution.
